name: Tm Visualization Suite: Hierarchy Explorer
pitch: See how a total splits into categories and sub-categories, and which branches carry the weight.
question: How is the whole built from its parts, level by level?
useWhen: Show how a total splits across levels of a hierarchy.
features: Spot the heavy groups in nested circles
Follow each path as a tree

hero.alt: Icicle chart of net sales by product group and sub-category, drawn as stacked columns with one colour per group.
hero.caption: Which product groups carry the sales, level by level

screenshots.alt: Radial tree with the top level in the centre and items on the outer ring, coloured by product group.
screenshots.caption: A radial tree fits a deep hierarchy into a round space

screenshots.alt: Top-down tree chart with product groups on the first row and items below, labels rotated.
screenshots.caption: Turn the tree top-down when the labels are short

questions: Which product groups make up most of our sales?
Where does one category split into many small items?
How do departments, groups and items nest?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who explain a total through its categories and sub-categories.

featureStrips.heading: Read a total as rings
featureStrips.text: A sunburst puts the top level in the centre and each deeper level in the next ring, sized by value.
featureStrips.alt: Sunburst chart with product groups in the inner ring and sub-categories and items in the outer rings.

featureStrips.heading: Compare levels side by side
featureStrips.text: An icicle lines the levels up as columns, so you can compare branch sizes across each level.
featureStrips.alt: Icicle chart with five levels from product group to item, one column per level.

featureStrips.heading: Spot the heavy groups in nested circles
featureStrips.text: Circle packing nests items inside their group, so the big groups and their parts show at one glance.
featureStrips.alt: Circle packing chart, large circles for product groups with smaller circles for items inside each.

featureStrips.heading: Follow each path as a tree
featureStrips.text: A tree draws every branch with its label, so you can read a path from the top down to a single item.
featureStrips.alt: Left-to-right tree with product groups, sub-categories and items, labelled on every branch.
